schema.text: Does walking as part of your daily travel contribute positively to your physical or mental health?

options.text: Not at all, I walk out of necessity, not choice
A little, I appreciate it but it is not significant
Moderately, it contributes to my overall activity level
Quite a lot, it is an important part of my daily physical activity
Very much, walking is a key part of my physical and mental wellbeing

en.#Does walking as part of your daily trav: Does walking as part of your daily travel contribute positively to your physical or mental health?

en.#Quite a lot, it is an important part of: Quite a lot, it is an important part of my daily physical activity

it.#Does walking as part of your daily trav: Camminare nell'ambito dei tuoi spostamenti quotidiani contribuisce positivamente alla tua salute fisica o mentale?
it.#Not at all, I walk out of necessity, no: Per niente, cammino per necessità e non per scelta
it.#A little, I appreciate it but it is not: Un po', lo apprezzo ma il contributo non è significativo
it.#Moderately, it contributes to my overal: Moderatamente, contribuisce al mio livello complessivo di attività fisica
it.#Quite a lot, it is an important part of: Abbastanza, è una parte importante della mia attività fisica quotidiana
it.#Very much, walking is a key part of my: Moltissimo, camminare è una componente fondamentale del mio benessere fisico e mentale

fr.#Does walking as part of your daily trav: Le fait de marcher dans vos déplacements quotidiens a-t-il un effet positif sur votre santé physique ou mentale ?
fr.#Not at all, I walk out of necessity, no: Pas du tout : je marche par nécessité, pas par choix
fr.#A little, I appreciate it but it is not: Un peu : j’apprécie la marche, mais son effet n’est pas important
fr.#Moderately, it contributes to my overal: Modérément : la marche contribue à mon niveau général d’activité physique
fr.#Quite a lot, it is an important part of: Beaucoup : la marche est une partie importante de mon activité physique quotidienne
fr.#Very much, walking is a key part of my: Énormément : la marche est essentielle à mon bien-être physique et mental

de.#Does walking as part of your daily trav: Hat das Gehen im Alltag einen positiven Einfluss auf Ihre körperliche oder psychische Gesundheit?
de.#Not at all, I walk out of necessity, no: Gar nicht — ich gehe aus Notwendigkeit zu Fuß, nicht weil ich es möchte
de.#A little, I appreciate it but it is not: Etwas — ich schätze das Gehen, aber der Einfluss ist nicht groß
de.#Moderately, it contributes to my overal: Mäßig — das Gehen trägt zu meiner allgemeinen körperlichen Aktivität bei
de.#Quite a lot, it is an important part of: Stark — das Gehen ist ein wichtiger Teil meiner täglichen Bewegung
de.#Very much, walking is a key part of my: Sehr stark — das Gehen ist ein wichtiger Teil meines körperlichen und psychischen Wohlbefindens

tr.#Does walking as part of your daily trav: Günlük yolculuklarınızda yürümenin fiziksel veya ruhsal sağlığınıza olumlu katkısı oluyor mu?
tr.#Not at all, I walk out of necessity, no: Hiç olmuyor — isteyerek değil, zorunlu olduğum için yürüyorum
tr.#A little, I appreciate it but it is not: Biraz oluyor — yürümeyi seviyorum ama etkisi çok büyük değil
tr.#Moderately, it contributes to my overal: Orta düzeyde — genel fiziksel aktiviteme katkı sağlıyor
tr.#Quite a lot, it is an important part of: Oldukça fazla — günlük fiziksel aktivitemin önemli bir parçası
tr.#Very much, walking is a key part of my: Çok fazla — yürümek fiziksel ve ruhsal iyi oluşumun önemli bir parçası

fa.#Does walking as part of your daily trav: آیا پیاده‌روی در رفت‌وآمد روزانه اثر مثبتی بر سلامت جسمی یا روانی شما دارد؟
fa.#Not at all, I walk out of necessity, no: اصلاً؛ از روی اجبار پیاده می‌روم نه انتخاب
fa.#A little, I appreciate it but it is not: کمی؛ پیاده‌روی را دوست دارم اما اثر آن زیاد نیست
fa.#Moderately, it contributes to my overal: تا حد متوسط؛ به میزان فعالیت جسمی کلی من کمک می‌کند
fa.#Quite a lot, it is an important part of: زیاد؛ بخش مهمی از فعالیت جسمی روزانه من است
fa.#Very much, walking is a key part of my: خیلی زیاد؛ پیاده‌روی بخش مهمی از سلامت جسمی و روانی من است

hu.#Does walking as part of your daily trav: Pozitívan hat a fizikai vagy lelki egészségére, hogy a mindennapi közlekedés részeként gyalogol?
hu.#Not at all, I walk out of necessity, no: Egyáltalán nem — szükségből gyalogolok, nem azért, mert ezt választom
hu.#A little, I appreciate it but it is not: Kissé — szeretem a gyaloglást, de a hatása nem jelentős
hu.#Moderately, it contributes to my overal: Közepesen — hozzájárul az általános fizikai aktivitásomhoz
hu.#Quite a lot, it is an important part of: Elég sokat — a napi testmozgásom fontos része
hu.#Very much, walking is a key part of my: Nagyon sokat — a gyaloglás fontos része a fizikai és lelki jóllétemnek

ar.#Does walking as part of your daily trav: هل يساهم المشي ضمن تنقلاتك اليومية بشكل إيجابي في صحتك البدنية أو النفسية؟
ar.#Not at all, I walk out of necessity, no: لا إطلاقًا — أمشي للضرورة وليس لأنه خياري
ar.#A little, I appreciate it but it is not: قليلًا — أقدّر المشي لكن أثره ليس كبيرًا
ar.#Moderately, it contributes to my overal: بدرجة متوسطة — يساهم في مستوى نشاطي البدني العام
ar.#Quite a lot, it is an important part of: بدرجة كبيرة — هو جزء مهم من نشاطي البدني اليومي
ar.#Very much, walking is a key part of my: بدرجة كبيرة جدًا — المشي جزء أساسي من صحتي البدنية والنفسية
